scope: Remove duplicate delivery-off guidance from quick capture in each independently owned app; verify the existing iPhone guidance action preserves the draft and reaches Reminders.
changes: ReminderAutomaticPreview accepts an optional delivery-guidance flag, defaulting to the existing behavior.
Quick capture suppresses only the automatic delivery-off line when its explicit custom-reminder guidance is already present. Automatic reminder meaning and ordinary editor guidance remain.
No persistence, reminder scheduling, permission or authentication contracts change.

nativePhone.coverage: Normal/light and AccessibilityXXXL/dark: complete suggestion above keyboard controls, select reminder, preserve resolved section/chips, exactly one delivery guide fully inside the scrolling capture viewport, tap guide, preserve Preview title, navigate to Reminders. Draft never saved; delivery not enabled.
nativePhone.visualInspection: Four captures inspected individually. Normal guidance wraps in two lines; largest guidance wraps fully after scrolling. Both destinations show Reminders and the selected 30-minute reminder. Largest destination needs scrolling for device delivery controls; this run does not claim those controls were tested.

macOS.scope: Independent Mac app/native-test products in local-only isolated stage. Widget extension omitted; no widget source changed. Native changed-copy verification pending.

macIsolation.startup: Manual local-only app launch loads its private fixture/cache; sampled main thread is in ordinary AppKit event loop, without protected cloud-session read.
macIsolation.failure: Initial app activation failed: Running Background. No bulk interaction occurred. Later computer-use inspection explicitly reported a locked desktop. This is not native acceptance.
macIsolation.currentLaunch: User-authorized separate local test app launched again and confirmed running; window inspection reports locked Mac. Original cloud app/cache preserved.

limitations: Mac native interaction, iPad/VoiceOver follow-up and broader provider, notification and distribution P0 gates remain open. This accepts the scoped phone capture route, not notification delivery.
